name: gg-property-document-duty
description: Prepare Guernsey property document-duty working papers for 2026 conveyances, including graduated rates, the repealed additional-property surcharge, conditional downsizing relief and transaction evidence. Use for document duty, property purchase costs, realty versus personalty and the 2025 surcharge transition. This source-cited draft covers the island of Guernsey and does not extend these rates to Alderney or Sark. It supplies recomputable examples using established chargeable realty values, not a valuation opinion. The new statutory extension supplies ordinary charging/valuation, named exemption gates, indirect-transfer self-assessment/payment and appeal methods, checked in the fresh whole-pack review. Complex valuations, relief claim administration and title advice remain separate requirements. Retain the transaction date, official source version and advocate's classification before relying on a calculation.
